proof_body:
by
  intro n a b h i hi
  have hp : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, Polynomial.C (a j) * Polynomial.X ^ j : Polynomial ℝ) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, Polynomial.C (b j) * Polynomial.X ^ j := by
    apply Polynomial.funext
    intro x
    simpa [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum] using h x
  have hc := congrArg (fun p => Polynomial.coeff p i) hp
  simpa [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, hi] using hc
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ x : ℝ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i * x ^ i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, b i * x ^ i) → ∀ i, i < n → a i = b i
